# Eduardo Osteicoechea — full agent corpus

Eduardo Osteicoechea (Eduardoos) is a licensed Building Architect who graduated from Universidad de Los Andes (ULA) Cum Laude. He is also a full-stack desktop, web, and cloud developer focused on AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) technology.

He completed focused BIM training: an Autodesk Authorized Training Center Course in 2011 and a BIMMASTER.org course. Those are professional training programs, not a Master’s degree. He builds Revit and AutoCAD API tools, AI integrations, and multiplatform products for AEC teams.

The public website https://eduardoos.com/ is a static Astro frontend. Browser clients call only same-origin `/api/` on eduardoos.com. The site does not expose MongoDB URIs, SMTP credentials, JWT secrets, or AI provider keys in the frontend.

Primary public pages:

- Home explains who he is, what he builds, and answers common questions.
- About expands credentials, craft, and how the site is operated.
- Contact lists public channels: email eduardooost@gmail.com, WhatsApp https://wa.me/584147281033, LinkedIn, GitHub, and YouTube.
- API docs describes the external API catalog for API-key clients; eReport bytes live on the VPS filesystem, not S3, and not in MongoDB.

Session, diagnostics, and eReport workspace routes are private UX surfaces and should not be treated as marketing or citation sources.

For a short index of URLs, see https://eduardoos.com/llms.txt
